description: Source code for fuel injection utility methods, including injector control, bench testing, and hardware interaction for an engine control system.

classes.name: OutputPin
classes.description: Represents an output pin for hardware control, with method to unregister the output.

methods.name: isRunningBenchTest
methods.description: Returns whether a bench test is currently running.

methods.name: assertCylinderId
methods.description: Validates the cylinder ID, asserts if invalid.

methods.name: isInjectorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific injector (by cylinder ID) is enabled.

methods.name: printInjectorsStatus
methods.description: Logs the status of all injectors.

methods.name: setInjectorEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific injector.

methods.name: runBench
methods.description: Performs a hardware bench test on a specified output pin with timing parameters.

methods.name: pinbench
methods.description: Prepares parameters for a bench test.

methods.name: doRunFuel
methods.description: Initiates a fuel injector bench test for a specific cylinder.

methods.name: fuelbench2
methods.description: Starts a fuel bench test with specified timing and count.

methods.name: fanBenchExt
methods.description: Starts a fan relay bench test.

methods.name: fanBench
methods.description: Runs a fan relay bench test for 3 seconds.

methods.name: milBench
methods.description: Runs a blinking indicator for 16 seconds.

methods.name: fuelPumpBenchExt
methods.description: Starts a fuel pump relay bench test.

methods.name: fuelPumpBench
methods.description: Runs a fuel pump relay bench test for 3 seconds.

methods.name: fuelbench
methods.description: Starts a fuel injector bench test.

methods.name: doRunSpark
methods.description: Initiates a spark bench test for a specific cylinder.

methods.name: sparkbench2
methods.description: Starts a spark bench test with specified timing and count.

methods.name: sparkbench
methods.description: Runs a spark bench test for a specified duration.

methods.name: dizzyBench
methods.description: Runs a dizzy output bench test.

methods.name: benchThread
methods.description: Thread function managing bench test execution.

methods.name: unregisterOutput
methods.description: Unregisters an output pin from hardware control.

methods.name: runBenchTest
methods.description: Executes a hardware bench test based on subsystem and index.

methods.name: initInjectorCentral
methods.description: Initializes the injector control system, sets up console commands and starts thread.
